question: Cardiomyocytes rely heavily on which mechanism to maintain their membrane potential and ensure proper contraction?

options.text: Passive diffusion through gap junctions only
A combination of voltage-gated ion channels and active ion pumps

solution:
The Correct answer is __**A combination of voltage-gated ion channels and active ion pumps**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Cardiomyocytes**, or heart muscle cells, rely heavily on a combination of **voltage-gated ion channels** and **active ion pumps** to maintain their **membrane potential** and ensure proper contraction.
